categories.name: FYI
categories.description: Personal or work updates written for me to read, such as announcements, status updates, or shared information, that are not newsletters or automated alerts.

categories.name: Marketing
categories.description: Promotions, newsletters, product announcements, sales, and other bulk mail sent to many recipients to sell or promote something.

categories.name: Comment
categories.description: A comment, mention, reply, or review on a shared document, issue, pull request, post, or thread.

categories.name: Notification
categories.description: Automated alerts from a service or system, such as security alerts, build results, shipping updates, account changes, or reminders.

categories.name: Receipt
categories.description: Receipts, invoices, order confirmations, payment confirmations, and billing statements.

categories.name: Meeting
categories.description: Calendar invitations, meeting requests, scheduling, rescheduling, cancellations, or meeting notes.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Email that does not clearly fit any other category.
